name: sUSD
oneLiner: Synthetix sUSD is an overcollateralized debt-pool stablecoin backed by SNX, ETH, and USDC; SNX minting was deprecated in 2025 and sUSD has traded below peg.
collateral: SNX, ETH, and USDC/stataUSDC via Synthetix V3; direct SNX minting deprecated in 2025; sUSD now backed primarily by delta-neutral basis-trade vaults and protocol treasury activity
pegMechanism: Overcollateralization via C-ratio (200%+); V3 expanded collateral to SNX, ETH, USDC/stataUSDC; sUSD minting against SNX deprecated in 2025; peg sustained via SLP Vault basis-trade strategy and protocol fee buybacks

reserves.name: Protocol treasury buybacks / SLP vault activity

notices.title: Prolonged depeg
notices.message: sUSD has traded materially below its $1 target since the SIP-420 C-ratio reduction. Use live runtime data for the current price; peg restoration is targeted for mid-2026 via the V3 transition and SLP vault strategy.

mintAuthority.summary: Synthetix sUSD is an overcollateralized debt-pool stablecoin; post-SIP-420 the legacy per-staker SNX mint is deprecated and minting/debt now sit in a protocol-owned pool, with the Synthetix DAO setting issuance and collateral parameters via SIP governance.

controls.label: Synthetix V3 / 420-pool minting contracts
controls.capDescription: Minting is bounded by the protocol-owned debt pool issuance ratio (~200% post-SIP-420) across SNX/ETH/USDC collateral types.
controls.evidence: SIP-420 docs and Synthetix coverage describe minting moving from individual SNX stakers to a protocol-owned debt pool; sUSD is issued by V3 collateral pools bounded by the pool issuance ratio.

controls.label: Synthetix governance (SIP process / DAO)
controls.evidence: Synthetix Improvement Proposals (SIPs), including SIP-420, set issuance ratios, accepted collateral, and pool parameters; the DAO/governance can authorize protocol minting of sUSD into products.

review.evidence: Synthetix SIP repository (notably SIP-420) and protocol coverage describe sUSD as an overcollateralized debt-pool stablecoin governed via the SIP process, with legacy per-staker SNX minting deprecated in favor of a protocol-owned debt pool; on-chain admin not independently confirmed.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the on-chain owner/admin of the V3 core, 420-pool, and legacy sUSD token contracts and the Synthetix governance multisig/timelock.
